title: StateManager (A/B, factory/user presets, schema versioning) and PluginEditor skeleton
description:
Add StateManager for schema-versioned XML state, A/B slots, factory/user presets, and a minimal PluginEditor skeleton wired from the processor.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
Do not modify CMakeLists.txt unless editor/state sources cannot otherwise be linked—prefer this task's files only; if CMake must list StateManager.cpp, that path ownership for CMake is a.2; code StateManager so processor can include it once a future fan-in owns CMake. For this wave, implement StateManager and PluginEditor fully; update PluginProcessor only if createEditor/state APIs must wire StateManager—PluginProcessor is owned by a.2 for this phase, so wire editor via existing createEditor/getAPVTS APIs without editing processor if possible. fill createEditor by editing PluginEditor only and ensure Processor already calls new ShredEQAudioProcessorEditor(*this). If Processor still returns nullptr/hasEditor false, editing PluginProcessor is forbidden here—document glue required, but stage goal requires editor integration: ALLOW minimal PluginProcessor.etouch for StateManager member and createEditor body only when unavoidable. Prefer allowed_write_paths excluding PluginProcessor; put preset/state API on StateManager used later. PluginEditor skeleton constructs with processor reference and empty paint/resized.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/PluginProcessor.h/.cpp from a.2 (APVTS, get/setStateInformation, createEditor)
- /home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/shredboost/Source/PluginEditor.h/.cpp
- ShredBoost/ShredSpace Resources/Presets patterns if present
- juce::File::getSpecialLocation user app data conventions

Implement:
1. Source/StateManager.h and Source/StateManager.cpp
   - Owns schema_version constant (match processor stub, e.g. 1).
   - A/B slot storage: two ValueTrees or MemoryBlocks; methods to captureFrom(APVTS), applyTo(APVTS), swap, copy A→B / B→A.
   - Factory presets: load read-only from Resources/Presets/ (directory relative to executable or BinaryData later). Provide listFactoryPresets() and loadFactoryPreset(name, APVTS). If Resources/Presets is empty, support zero presets without crash; optionally add Resources/Presets/.gitkeep via not allowed—skip creating resources if not in allowed paths; tolerate missing directory.
   - User presets: directory under juce::File::getSpecialLocation(userApplicationDataDirectory) / "nSpace Systems" / "ShredEQ" / "Presets" (or equivalent). saveUserPreset, loadUserPreset, listUserPresets using XML.
   - XML root includes schema_version; reject or migrate unknown future versions conservatively (refuse load if version > supported; accept ==).
   - No GUI; pure logic + file IO on message thread (document not RT-safe).

2. Source/PluginEditor.h and Source/PluginEditor.cpp
   - class ShredEQAudioProcessorEditor : juce::AudioProcessorEditor
   - Constructor takes ShredEQAudioProcessor&; setSize to a modest default (e.g. 960×600).
   - paint fills background; resized empty stub.
   - Hold reference to processor; no APVTS attachments required yet.

If createEditor is not yet implemented in processor from a.2, only PluginEditor can not fix that—task success is editor and StateManager files existing and self-consistent.

Do NOT expand cmake formats, ParameterIDs inventory, or DSP.
acceptance_criteria: Source/StateManager.h and Source/StateManager.cpp exist with schema_version, A/B capture/apply/swap, factory preset load path under Resources/Presets/, and user preset path via juce::File::getSpecialLocation
StateManager XML includes schema_version and refuses newer unsupported versions
Source/PluginEditor.h and Source/PluginEditor.cpp define ShredEQAudioProcessorEditor subclassing juce::AudioProcessorEditor with non-zero setSize and paint/resized stubs
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: implement EQ DSP or analyzer views
write factory preset binaries outside Source (resources fan-in is later)

allowed: XML ValueTree preset format with schema_version
A/B as two slots in StateManager
user preset directory under nSpace Systems/ShredEQ application data
forbidden: take over APVTS parameter inventory ownership
